messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance — iManage DMS, Sunday 6 April 02:00–06:00 BST
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear All,

The document management system (iManage) will be unavailable this Sunday 6 April between 02:00 and 06:00 BST for a security patch. Please check in any open documents before Friday close of business. Email and the practice management system are unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
